evidence: Matches the P2P label and modifies AddrMan collision selection and feeler connection logic in ThreadOpenConnections.
rationale: Prevents feeler connections from stalling for up to 40 minutes when an unreachable tried collision is repeatedly selected after network configuration changes. As noted in the description, this addresses a rare occurrence when switching network configurations (e.g., dropping Tor for -onlynet=ipv4) where feelers halt until ADDRMAN_TEST_WINDOW clears the entry, making it a worthwhile but non-critical liveness bug fix.
